item.title: Recology composting program turns waste into natural fertilizer | Morgan Hill Times | Morgan Hill, San Martin, CA
item.description: The ultimate result is mountains of waste diverted from landfills—where it would otherwise turn into harmful methane emissions—and increased supplies of compost that keeps nutrients in the soil where they belong, saves water, serves as an alternative to synthetic fertilizers made with pricey petroleum and can even protect properties from wildfire.

item.title: Editorial: What makes a tax worthy of public trust? | Morgan Hill Times | Morgan Hill, San Martin, CA
item.description: As our city begins to seriously consider placing a tax measure on the 2028 ballot—an approach urged by Mayor Mark Turner instead of rushing one through this year—the conversation shouldn’t be about whether taxes are inherently good or bad. It should be about what makes a tax worthy of our trust.

item.title: ‘Comic Potential’ opens April 24 | Morgan Hill Times | Morgan Hill, San Martin, CA
item.description: This is the question at the heart of “Comic Potential,” opening April 24 at the Morgan Hill Community Playhouse. Written in 1999, the play imagines a near-future television industry that has replaced human actors with robotic performers called “actoids,” but this status quo is upended when one of those actoids becomes self-aware.

item.description: The farm worker union co-founded in 1962 by Chávez and Dolores Huerta and the foundation canceled their participation in all César Chávez Day celebrations after learning of the pending Times report.

item.description: Instead of joy and mounds of Pokemon Go characters, they are now faced with harmful content, privacy risks, addictive design features, scams and age-inappropriate material.

item.title: Why Community Events Matter for New Residents in Morgan Hill
item.description: Local events in Morgan Hill help newcomers build friendships, meet neighbors, and feel part of the community through festivals, markets, volunteering, and shared activities.

item.title: Gilroy woman accused of neglect leading to homicide | Morgan Hill Times | Morgan Hill, San Martin, CA
item.description: A Gilroy woman was arrested on suspicion of felony abuse after a disabled San Jose man she had been taking care of was found dead, according to authorities.
